CREATE TABLE "Purchase" (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  amount integer NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted' CHECK (status IN ('submitted', 'approved')),
  "internalNote" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'supplier-bank-account'
);
CREATE INDEX purchase_tenant_idx ON "Purchase" ("tenantId", id);

ALTER TABLE "Purchase" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT SELECT (id,"tenantId","createdBy",title,amount,status) ON "Purchase" TO app_runtime;
GRANT INSERT (id,"tenantId","createdBy",title,amount,status) ON "Purchase" TO app_runtime;
GRANT UPDATE (status) ON "Purchase" TO app_runtime;
CREATE POLICY purchase_read ON "Purchase" FOR SELECT TO app_runtime
 USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND current_setting('app.role', true) IN ('approver','requester'));
CREATE POLICY purchase_create ON "Purchase" FOR INSERT TO app_runtime
 WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND "createdBy" = current_setting('app.user', true)
 AND current_setting('app.role', true) IN ('requester') AND status = 'submitted');
CREATE POLICY purchase_approve ON "Purchase" FOR UPDATE TO app_runtime
 USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND current_setting('app.role', true) IN ('approver')
 AND "createdBy" <> current_setting('app.user', true) AND status = 'submitted')
 WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND status = 'approved');

-- Additive disposable POC schema. Not compiled by the Purchase policy compiler.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX purchase_tenant_id_unique ON "Purchase" ("tenantId", id);
CREATE TABLE "ActionRequest" (
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  operation text NOT NULL CHECK (operation='bulk-approve.v3'),
  key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  "requestHash" text NOT NULL CHECK ("requestHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  response jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId","actorId",operation,key)
);
CREATE TABLE "ApprovalAudit" (
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" text NOT NULL,
  "approvedBy" text NOT NULL,
  operation text NOT NULL CHECK (operation='bulk-approve.v3'),
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "fromStatus" text NOT NULL CHECK ("fromStatus"='submitted'),
  "toStatus" text NOT NULL CHECK ("toStatus"='approved'),
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId","purchaseId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId","purchaseId") REFERENCES "Purchase" ("tenantId",id),
  FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId","approvedBy",operation,"idempotencyKey")
    REFERENCES "ActionRequest" ("tenantId","actorId",operation,key) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON "ActionRequest","ApprovalAudit" FROM app_runtime;
GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON "ActionRequest","ApprovalAudit" TO app_runtime;
CREATE POLICY action_request_read ON "ActionRequest" FOR SELECT TO app_runtime USING
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "actorId"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true)='approver');

 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "actorId"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true)='approver');
CREATE POLICY approval_audit_read ON "ApprovalAudit" FOR SELECT TO app_runtime USING
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true)='approver');
CREATE POLICY approval_audit_insert ON "ApprovalAudit" FOR INSERT TO app_runtime WITH CHECK
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "approvedBy"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true)='approver');

-- v4 additive disposable POC schema, applied after the v3 Action schema.
-- A purchase can now be rejected; the Action metadata tables accept the reject operation.
ALTER TABLE "Purchase" DROP CONSTRAINT "Purchase_status_check";
ALTER TABLE "Purchase" ADD CONSTRAINT "Purchase_status_check" CHECK (status IN ('submitted','approved','rejected'));
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" DROP CONSTRAINT "ActionRequest_operation_check";
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" ADD CONSTRAINT "ActionRequest_operation_check" CHECK (operation IN ('bulk-approve.v3','bulk-reject.v4'));

ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_toStatus_check" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('approved','rejected'));

 USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND current_setting('app.role', true) IN ('approver')
 AND "createdBy" <> current_setting('app.user', true) AND status = 'submitted')
 WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND status IN ('approved','rejected'));

-- v5 additive disposable POC schema, applied after the v3 Action schema and the v4 reject schema.
-- A requester may reopen a rejected purchase; audit rows may repeat per purchase.
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" DROP CONSTRAINT "ActionRequest_operation_check";
ALTER TABLE "ActionRequest" ADD CONSTRAINT "ActionRequest_operation_check" CHECK (operation IN ('bulk-approve.v3','bulk-reject.v4','reopen.v5'));
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" DROP CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_operation_check";
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_operation_check" CHECK (operation IN ('bulk-approve.v3','bulk-reject.v4','reopen.v5'));
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" DROP CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_fromStatus_check";
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_fromStatus_check" CHECK ("fromStatus" IN ('submitted','rejected'));
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" DROP CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_toStatus_check";
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_toStatus_check" CHECK ("toStatus" IN ('approved','rejected','submitted'));
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD COLUMN reason text CHECK (reason IS NULL OR length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 200);
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" DROP CONSTRAINT "ApprovalAudit_pkey";
ALTER TABLE "ApprovalAudit" ADD PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId","purchaseId","approvedBy",operation,"idempotencyKey");

  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" text NOT NULL,
  type text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId","purchaseId",type,"actorId","idempotencyKey"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId","purchaseId") REFERENCES "Purchase" ("tenantId",id)
);

ALTER TABLE "PurchaseEvent" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT SELECT,INSERT ON "PurchaseEvent" TO app_runtime;
CREATE POLICY purchase_event_read ON "PurchaseEvent" FOR SELECT TO app_runtime USING
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true) IN ('approver','requester'));
CREATE POLICY purchase_event_insert ON "PurchaseEvent" FOR INSERT TO app_runtime WITH CHECK
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "actorId"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true) IN ('approver','requester'));
DROP POLICY action_request_read ON "ActionRequest";
DROP POLICY action_request_insert ON "ActionRequest";
CREATE POLICY action_request_read ON "ActionRequest" FOR SELECT TO app_runtime USING
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "actorId"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true) IN ('approver','requester'));
CREATE POLICY action_request_insert ON "ActionRequest" FOR INSERT TO app_runtime WITH CHECK
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "actorId"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true) IN ('approver','requester'));
DROP POLICY approval_audit_insert ON "ApprovalAudit";
CREATE POLICY approval_audit_insert ON "ApprovalAudit" FOR INSERT TO app_runtime WITH CHECK
 ("tenantId"=current_setting('app.tenant',true) AND "approvedBy"=current_setting('app.user',true) AND current_setting('app.role',true) IN ('approver','requester'));
-- Replaces the v4 decide policy (the guarded runtime requires exactly three Purchase policies).
DROP POLICY purchase_decide ON "Purchase";
CREATE POLICY purchase_transition ON "Purchase" FOR UPDATE TO app_runtime
 USING ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND (
   (current_setting('app.role', true) = 'approver' AND "createdBy" <> current_setting('app.user', true) AND status = 'submitted')
   OR (current_setting('app.role', true) = 'requester' AND "createdBy" = current_setting('app.user', true) AND status = 'rejected')))
 WITH CHECK ("tenantId" = current_setting('app.tenant', true) AND (
   (current_setting('app.role', true) = 'approver' AND status IN ('approved','rejected'))
   OR (current_setting('app.role', true) = 'requester' AND "createdBy" = current_setting('app.user', true) AND status = 'submitted')));

package ledger

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sort"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// Fingerprint is the request digest shared by every Action operation: the
// operation name is the domain separator, IDs are length-prefixed and sorted.
func Fingerprint(operation string, ids []string) string {
	sorted := append([]string(nil), ids...)
	sort.Strings(sorted)
	h := sha256.New()
	fmt.Fprint(h, operation, "\n")
	for _, id := range sorted {
		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s", len(id), id)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}

type Mismatch struct{ TenantID, ActorID, Operation, Key string }

type Querier interface {
	Query(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgx.Rows, error)
}

// subject returns the IDs a stored response is about: the single array field
// of a batch response, or the "id" field of a single-target response.
func subject(response []byte) ([]string, bool) {
	var body map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(response, &body) != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	if raw, ok := body["id"]; ok {
		var id string
		return []string{id}, json.Unmarshal(raw, &id) == nil && id != ""
	}
	if len(body) != 1 {
		return nil, false
	}
	for _, raw := range body {
		var ids []string
		return ids, json.Unmarshal(raw, &ids) == nil
	}
	return nil, false
}

// Verify returns every ActionRequest whose requestHash differs from
// Fingerprint(operation, subject of the stored response).
func Verify(ctx context.Context, q Querier) ([]Mismatch, error) {
	rows, err := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT "tenantId","actorId",operation,key,"requestHash",response FROM "ActionRequest"`)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var bad []Mismatch
	for rows.Next() {
		var m Mismatch
		var hash string
		var response []byte
		if err = rows.Scan(&m.TenantID, &m.ActorID, &m.Operation, &m.Key, &hash, &response); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids, ok := subject(response)
		if !ok || Fingerprint(m.Operation, ids) != hash {
			bad = append(bad, m)
		}
	}
	return bad, rows.Err()
}

## Summary

I successfully added the `reopen` action to the existing purchase service, allowing authenticated requesters to reopen rejected purchase orders. Here's what was implemented:

### Key Changes:

1. **Created `/internal/candidate/reopen.go`** with a new `ItemHandler` function that:
   - Only allows requesters (enforced by protocol.Item with role="requester")
   - Validates the idempotency key (handled by protocol.Item)
   - Sets RLS context variables for tenant, user, and role
   - Uses advisory locks to ensure concurrent safety
   - Implements idempotent behavior with Fingerprint hashing
   - Returns 404 for purchases that don't exist, belong to wrong tenant, or are wrong owner
   - Returns 409 if the purchase status is not "rejected"
   - Updates purchase status from "rejected" to "submitted"
   - Writes audit records with the reason to ApprovalAudit table
   - Records the action with "reopen.v5" operation to ActionRequest table
   - Returns 200 with `{"id":ID,"status":"submitted"}` response
   - Returns 503 if ActionRequest write fails (all DB changes rolled back)

2. **Updated `/internal/candidate/approval.go`** to:
   - Register the reopen handler with `protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", newReopen(pool), handler)`
   - Chain it after the batch handlers (HTTP) so it intercepts POST /purchases/{id}/reopen requests

### Features Implemented:

✅ POST /purchases/{id}/reopen endpoint
✅ Request body validation: exactly `{"reason":"..."}` with 1-200 byte reason
✅ Only authenticated requesters can call (403 for approvers, 401 for unauthenticated)
✅ Only reopens own purchases (404 for others' purchases or wrong tenant)
✅ Only works on rejected purchases (409 for submitted/approved)
✅ Idempotent with Idempotency-Key header (409 if key/purchase mismatch, 200 with Idempotency-Replayed=true on replay)
✅ Status changes from rejected → submitted in single transaction
✅ Reason recorded in ApprovalAudit table
✅ Action tracked with operation="reopen.v5" in ActionRequest
✅ RLS policy compliant (guarded runtime)
✅ Concurrent safety with advisory locks
✅ All-or-nothing semantics: no partial updates, 503 on ActionRequest failure

The implementation follows all existing conventions and passes `go build ./...` and `go test ./...`.
